data.why: The repo's own build pipeline (bin/post_compile, the Figshare/NCBI downloads it describes) is not present in this checkout and build_db.py only reads local data/raw/*.csv with no network calls, so synthetic CSVs matching PLSDB's exact schema were written so build_db.py produces a real local plsdb.db covering every table, correlation and AMR/mobility/geography feature the dashboard queries.

goals: survey the overall composition of the plasmid collection (topology, source, kingdom, length and GC distributions)
find which host genera and species carry the most plasmids
identify which AMR drug classes and resistance genes are most frequent and which Inc groups/mobility types they associate with
characterize incompatibility groups, predicted mobility, relaxase/MPF typing and pMLST schemes across the collection
look for cross-feature correlations such as AMR vs mobility, heavy-metal co-resistance, toxin-antitoxin systems, phage elements and class 1 integrons
visualize the geographic and temporal spread of plasmids and inspect an individual plasmid's gene map (CDS, AMR, MOB, TA, virulence) in the circular viewer

review.summary: The tree tracks the README's purpose closely, its phases follow the dashboard's real stages, and all nine screens I opened match their nodes. It needs light fixes before filing: split the combined UMAP/temporal task, record the empty Analytics confound panels and the viewer tracks that were never exercised, and add the co-occurrence heatmap as a feature.
